eval_line: eFV 3.4 F-SIDE -- standing joint side-fairness eval (measurement-only; output-neutral)
question: do pitchers at a given joint-board slot / display grade deliver worse realized outcomes than hitters at the same slot, and does any future change widen that gap?

protocol.display_map: per-side rank-preserving quantile map of rank_war onto the side's consensus-FV distribution, replicated within each fold-year test pool. LABEL CORRECTED 2026-08-04: this is the analogue of xfv_grade_display, which was RETIRED as the served display on 2026-07-25 and now serves only as the SURPLUS-PRICING basis. It is not the served board grade.
protocol.joint_board: both sides unioned; ranked by the quantile map above (the surplus-pricing basis, formerly the display) and by raw rank_war WAR units (calibration-honest). NOTE: the served board grade is raw xfv_grade (storage.BOARD_GRADE_FIELD), so neither leg is a direct read on served board order; re-basing this eval is a gate decision, recorded here rather than done silently.
protocol.war_metric: first-6yr summed label WAR, rate-projected tail (target_censored)
protocol.provenance: 2026-07 side_fairness prototype verbatim; headline top-25 +3.95 CI90 [1.55, 6.35] reproduced

B1_fold_sign_agreement.rule: >=3/4 forward-chained folds agree with the pooled sign of the joint top-25 hit-minus-pit mean-WAR diff (primary frame)

B2_dual_frame_sign.rule: full-pool-KM and debuted-only top-25 mean diffs share a sign

B3_ipcw_identity_where_uncensored.rule: IPCW estimate sign-preserving AND within 1 bootstrap SE of unweighted on the resolved <=2018 decision folds

B4_ci90_excludes_zero.rule: S1 co-primary: top-25 mean-diff AND median-diff CI90 exclude 0

binding_grade_cell.binding: equal display grade >= 55 (grade >= 52.5 on the round-to-nearest eFV scale; cell '55_plus_binding')

diagnostic_50_band.note: the 50-band model-vs-realized discrepancy is a TRACKED DIAGNOSTIC, never a gate (pre-registered)

S1_top25_no_widening.rule: S1: joint TOP-25 hit-minus-pit realized-WAR diff must not increase by >1 bootstrap SE (mean AND median co-primary)

S2_hit_no_harm.rule: S2: hit pooled blend Spearman must stay within 0.0023 of the corrected-label baseline

S3_pit_bucket_logloss.rule: S3: pit BENCH+GOOD bucket log-loss <= +1.0% relative

S4_midband_pit_outperformance.rule: S4: rank_war-frame mid-band pit-outperformance cells (51-100, 101-200, equal-FV40) must not flip sign
S4_midband_pit_outperformance.expected_sign: negative (pitchers outperform hitters at equal raw mid-board slot / equal FV40)

S5_fold_guards_and_2024_tripwire.rule: S5: stamp per-side fold-year counts vs the >=15 test / >=60 train guards; the FIRST run where the 2024 decision fold becomes trainable must re-run E-ISO4-path, M3 and E-STUFF before re-baselining this line

first_trainable_2024_fold.full_pool_2024_note: full-pool 2024 cell passes the raw guards on bust rows alone (no debuted rows); the trip condition is the DEBUTED 2024 fold

output_neutrality.claim: measurement-only: no scorer/producer/payload writer touched; every published player number (data/xfv.json payloads) is byte-identical
writes: side_fairness summary block in data/xfv_eval.json + data/xfv_eval_pitcher.json
